name: Kuchihateta Shizumu Sora no Inori
original_name: 朽ち果てた沈む空の祈り
source:
Main character wakes up without any memories in the world full of battles, countries decay and disease. After the age of 20 people start to get their limbs deformed and lose different senses with the death coming after 48 hours up to several years. He begins a journey to find a place he belongs to.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在一个充满战争、国家腐朽与疾病的世界醒来，却失去了全部记忆。人过了20岁便开始四肢变形、失去各种感官，并在48小时到数年后死亡。他踏上旅程，寻找一个属于自己的地方。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
